name: EvyaCreateStory
description: Draft a complete user story from project context and (on approval) push it to Azure DevOps + notify Teams.

name: EvyaCreateSubtask
description: Break a story into developer-ready subtasks. Pass StoryID as argument e.g. EVYA-1042.

name: EvyaStartDev
description: Kick off development — runs a technical brainstorm (3+ approaches, team approval) then branch/PR/DoR gates. Pass StoryID.

name: EvyaFinishDev
description: Wrap development — AC coverage audit, diff check, Dev Summary, transition to Ready for QA. Pass StoryID.

name: EvyaStartQa
description: Generate a comprehensive test plan and transition the story to In QA. Pass StoryID.

name: EvyaFinishQa
description: Validate QA pass, draft release notes, transition the story to Done. Pass StoryID.
